title: FDR's Vatican communications via envoy Myron Taylor

tellings.quote: Remember that FDR was responsible for the communications with the Vatican about the [music] crashed Magenta craft.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that President Franklin D. Roosevelt, known as FDR, handled communications with the Vatican in the 1940s about a crashed craft the tellers call the "Magenta" craft. The link, as told, ran through his envoy Myron Taylor. If true, it would mean a US president and the Catholic Church were sharing secrets about a crash before the end of the war.
